freeze_boundary: Draft only. Materializes the FP-001 requirement that a decision carries its reason AND source, the FP-002 precedence as an in-order prefix of platform -> plan -> workspace -> business -> capability with a kill switch as a platform-scope deny, the FP-003 requirement that a percentage decision shows its allocation, and the FP-005 expiry and owner for a temporary flag. What FP-002 requires BEYOND a single document - that a narrower scope cannot override a platform kill switch - is NOT materialized: one decision document cannot express a conflict between two decisions, so the guarantee lives in an evaluator that does not exist yet. An earlier version of this manifest claimed FP-002 was materialized while untestable_by_fixture disclaimed it; independent security review and independent review both found the contradiction.
untestable_by_fixture: FP-003 stable allocation - the same workspace stays in the same bucket across evaluations - and the ENFORCEMENT half of FP-002, that a business-scope allow cannot override a live platform kill switch. Both are properties of an evaluator over repeated or multiple inputs; a single decision document cannot express two conflicting decisions, so no fixture can demonstrate either. The ORDER half of FP-002 is expressible and is now enforced by the evaluated_scopes prefix enum. They need an evaluator harness before freeze.
